description: Draft (text only; nothing is sent) a firm, polite letter asking a company to reverse or refund one specific fee, with grounds, a 14-day written-response request, an escalation path and sending tips. Use once the user has picked a fee to contest. To find which fees are worth disputing first, use audit_fees.

account_reference.description: Optional account or reference number; prefer a masked form like '****1234'

amount.description: Fee amount in USD, greater than 0, e.g. 38

company.description: Company or bank that charged the fee, e.g. 'First National Bank'

date_charged.description: Optional date the fee was charged, free text, e.g. 2026-09-14

fee_name.description: Name of the fee being disputed, e.g. 'Overdraft fee'

reason.description: Optional grounds for the dispute; default cites an undisclosed/unexpected charge and asks for a courtesy reversal

requested_action.description: What to ask the company to do, e.g. 'waive' or 'refund'; default 'reverse or refund'

your_name.description: Account holder's full name, used in From and to sign the letter

name: dispute_letter

disclaimer.description: Not legal or financial advice disclaimer

letter.description: Full letter text with To/From/Subject header and signature

sending_tips.description: Practical tips for sending, following up and escalating

subject.description: Subject line, e.g. Request to reverse or refund the $38.00 fee

title: Dispute letter
